description: List the archive's visit history for one repository URL, newest first: when each capture ran, what it produced, and whether it succeeded ("full"), partially succeeded, or failed ("not_found" — the origin was unreachable at that moment). Use this to see how continuously a project has been captured, and to distinguish "never archived" from "archived for years and unreachable this week". Sourced from the Software Heritage archive.
name: origin_visits
title: Origin Visits
